name: config-ts-app-solid
title: Typescript Config SolidJs Application
description: A typescript config for SolidJs applications.

files.content:
{
  "$schema": "https://json.schemastore.org/tsconfig",
  "display": "SolidJs App TSConfig",
  "extends": "./tsconfig.base.json",
  "compilerOptions": {
    "strict": true,
    "esModuleInterop": true,
    "target": "ESNext",
    "module": "ESNext",
    "moduleResolution": "Bundler",
    "jsx": "preserve",
    "jsxImportSource": "solid-js",
    "lib": ["DOM", "DOM.Iterable", "ES2022"],
    "noEmit": true,
    "allowJs": true,
    "isolatedModules": true,
    "resolveJsonModule": true,
    "forceConsistentCasingInFileNames": true,
    "paths": {
      "~/*": ["./src/*"]
    },
    "types": ["@types/node", "vite/client"]
  },
  "exclude": [
    "node_modules/",
    "build/",
    "dist/",
    "scripts/",
    "public/",
    ".wrangler/",
    ".vinxi/",
    ".vercel/",
    ".tmp/"
  ]
}
